# namespace_http_cache (Ephemeral Resource)

Ensures generic HTTP remote build cache infrastructure and obtains short-lived basic-auth credentials and endpoint URL. Warning: Opening this ephemeral resource invokes an Ensure RPC that may create or reuse durable server-side cache infrastructure. Terraform does not manage the lifecycle of the underlying cache and will not delete it when destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

ephemeral "namespace_http_cache" "artifacts" {
  name = "generic-http-cache"
  site = "us"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name identifier of the HTTP cache.

### Optional

- `site` (String) Optional site/region hint for cache placement. Computed from API response if omitted.

### Read-Only

- `cache_endpoint_url` (String) HTTP(S) URL for remote HTTP build cache.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the issued credentials expire.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic Auth password for cache access.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic Auth username for cache access.
